representation_note: Packed storage is4m(m+1) bytes. Lower-packed columns have lengths m,m-1,... and leading subcores are not contiguous prefixes. Upper-packed columns have lengths1,2,...; leading m factor is exactly the firstm(m+1)/2 entries, verified by independent dense solves.
